categories.main_business_segments: Laplace Renewable Energy Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the development, manufacturing, and sales of high-performance thermal processing, coating, and supporting automation equipment for new high-efficiency photovoltaic (PV) cells and semiconductor discrete devices. The company also provides related parts, equipment maintenance, and upgrade services. Its product portfolio covers core process equipment for PV cell manufacturing, including diffusion, coating, and automation systems, as well as semiconductor device equipment such as oxidation, annealing, and coating furnaces.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced technologies such as low-pressure horizontal boron diffusion, large-capacity LPCVD (Low Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition), precise heating and temperature control, high-temperature gas-phase reaction with horizontal wafer placement, uniform gas flow and precise gas control, and special materials for high-temperature durability. It also develops third-generation semiconductor ultra-high temperature oxidation and annealing technology and intelligent automated loading/unloading systems. The production is mainly made-to-order, customized to client specifications, emphasizing platform-based product development and continuous innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Laplace serves leading photovoltaic cell manufacturers and semiconductor device producers, including major industry players like LONGi Green Energy, JinkoSolar, Aiko Solar, Zhonglai, and others. Its products are used in the manufacturing of high-efficiency N-type PV cells (TOPCon, XBC) and semiconductor discrete devices (SiC-based). The company’s customer base is concentrated, with the top five customers accounting for over 76% of sales, reflecting strong relationships with key industry leaders.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with subsidiaries and operations in key regions including Shenzhen, Wuxi, Guangzhou, Zhuhai, Xi’an, and overseas entities in Hong Kong and Singapore. Its sales cover domestic markets extensively and also include significant exports, particularly to Southeast Asia, with overseas sales growing rapidly.
categories.supply_chain_position: Laplace operates in the midstream segment of the photovoltaic and semiconductor supply chain, providing specialized manufacturing equipment and process solutions essential for producing photovoltaic cells and semiconductor discrete devices. It supports downstream manufacturers by supplying core process equipment and automation solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment focused on advancing core technologies in thermal processing, coating, automation, and materials science to support evolving PV cell technologies such as TOPCon, XBC, HJT, perovskite, and tandem cells. It actively develops new products like ALD and EPD systems and explores semiconductor device equipment innovations. Laplace emphasizes building a strong IP portfolio and collaborates with top research institutions to accelerate innovation and maintain industry leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Laplace generates revenue primarily through direct sales of specialized equipment and related parts to PV and semiconductor manufacturers. It also earns income from equipment maintenance, upgrades, and retrofit services. The company follows a make-to-order production model with direct sales channels, including bidding and direct client engagement.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Laplace is positioned as a leading domestic supplier and innovator in high-efficiency photovoltaic cell manufacturing equipment, particularly for N-type cell technologies. It holds a strong market position with recognized technological advantages and has been awarded national-level honors such as the 'Manufacturing Industry Single Champion.' The company faces competition from other domestic and international PV equipment manufacturers but maintains a competitive edge through its technology and customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Laplace achieved revenue of approximately RMB 5.73 billion, representing a 93.12% year-over-year increase, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 729 million, up 77.53%. The company’s total assets were about RMB 10.1 billion, with net assets increasing by nearly 68%. It has shown rapid growth driven by strong market demand and technological leadership, supported by increased R&D spending (about 5.16% of revenue).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Laplace emphasizes its technological innovation and deep expertise in core PV cell process equipment, offering highly customized, high-performance solutions that improve cell efficiency and yield. Its proprietary low-pressure horizontal boron diffusion and large-capacity LPCVD technologies address industry bottlenecks, enabling customers to achieve advanced N-type cell production. The company’s integrated automation and precise process control technologies enhance production efficiency and reliability, differentiating it from competitors and fostering strong customer loyalty.
